name: four turns return to original
test:
image = [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]
turned = image
for _ in range(4):
    turned = rotate_clockwise(turned)
assert turned == image

name: input and output rows are independent
test:
image = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
turned = rotate_clockwise(image)
assert image == [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
turned[0][0] = 99
assert image == [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
